title.zh: 卷430 列傳二百十七 雷正绾 陶茂林 曹克忠 胡中和 何胜必 萧庆高 杨復东 周达武 李辉武 唐友耕
title.en: Volume 430 Biographies 217: Lei Zhengwan, Tao Maolin, Cao Kezhong, Hu Zhonghe, He Shengbi, Xiao Qinggao, Yang Fudong, Zhou Dawu, Li Huiwu, Tang Yougeng
title.raw: 卷430 列傳二百十七 雷正绾 陶茂林 曹克忠 胡中和 何胜必 萧庆高 杨復东 周达武 李辉武 唐友耕

sentences.zh: 列傳二百十七

translations.literal: Biographies 217
translations.idiomatic: Biographies 217

sentences.zh: 雷正綰陶茂林曹克忠胡中和何勝必蕭慶高楊復東

translations.literal: Lei Zhengwan, Tao Maolin, Cao Kezhong, Hu Zhonghe, He Shengbi, Xiao Qinggao, Yang Fudong
translations.idiomatic: Lei Zhengwan, Tao Maolin, Cao Kezhong, Hu Zhonghe, He Shengbi, Xiao Qinggao, Yang Fudong

sentences.zh: 周達武李輝武唐友耕

translations.literal: Zhou Dawu, Li Huiwu, Tang Yougeng
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Dawu, Li Huiwu, Tang Yougeng

sentences.zh: 雷正綰，字偉堂，四川中江人。

translations.literal: Lei Zhengwan, courtesy name Weitang, was a native of Zhongjiang, Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Lei Zhengwan, whose style was Weitang, came from Zhongjiang in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 由把總從軍湖北，積功至游擊，賜號直勇巴圖魯。

translations.literal: Beginning as a platoon officer, he joined the army in Hubei, rose through accumulated merit to colonel, and was granted the title Zhiyong Baturu.
translations.idiomatic: He entered service as a platoon officer in Hubei, won promotion through merit to colonel, and was given the honorific Zhiyong Baturu.

sentences.zh: 咸豐八年，從多隆阿援安徽石牌、潛山、太湖、桐城，諸戰皆功最，累擢副將，以總兵記名。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Xianfeng he followed Duo Longa to relieve Anhui at Shipai, Qianshan, Taihu, and Tongcheng; in every battle his merit was foremost. He was repeatedly promoted to deputy general and enrolled by name as brigade general.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Xianfeng (1858) he followed Duo Longa to relieve Anhui at Shipai, Qianshan, Taihu, and Tongcheng, distinguishing himself in every engagement. He was promoted repeatedly to deputy general and placed on the rolls as brigade general.

sentences.zh: 十一年，敗黃文金於蔣家山、項家河、江家河、麻子嶺，一月五捷，授陝安鎮總兵。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he defeated Huang Wencheng at Jiangjiashan, Xiangjiahe, Jiangjiahe, and Maziling — five victories in one month — and was appointed brigade general of the Shaan'an Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he defeated Huang Wencheng at Jiangjiashan, Xiangjiahe, Jiangjiahe, and Maziling, winning five battles in a single month, and was appointed brigade general of Shaan'an Garrison.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，克廬州，以提督記名。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he took Luzhou and was enrolled by name as provincial military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi (1862) he captured Luzhou and was placed on the rolls as provincial military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 從多隆阿援陝西，詔正綰先赴本任，未至，擢陝西提督，幫辦軍務，駐西安。

translations.literal: Following Duo Longa to relieve Shaanxi, the court ordered Zhengwan to proceed first to his regular post; before he arrived he was promoted to Shaanxi provincial military commissioner, assigned to assist in military affairs, and stationed at Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: When he followed Duo Longa to relieve Shaanxi, the court ordered Zhengwan to proceed to his post ahead of the main force. Before he arrived he was promoted to Shaanxi provincial military commissioner, assigned to assist in military affairs, and stationed at Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 二年，多隆阿既克東路，令正綰規三原，屢破賊。

translations.literal: In the second year, after Duo Longa had cleared the eastern route, he ordered Zhengwan to plan operations against Sanyuan, and Zhengwan repeatedly defeated the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, once Duo Longa had secured the eastern route, he ordered Zhengwan to advance against Sanyuan, and Zhengwan defeated the rebels again and again.

sentences.zh: 會解鳳翔圍，進援甘肅，連戰靈臺、鎮原，皆捷。

translations.literal: He then helped lift the siege of Fengxiang, advanced to relieve Gansu, and won successive victories at Lingtai and Zhenyuan.
translations.idiomatic: He helped raise the siege of Fengxiang, pushed forward to relieve Gansu, and won successive victories at Lingtai and Zhenyuan.

sentences.zh: 三年，破賊崇仁、新城，進逼平原。

translations.literal: In the third year he defeated rebels at Chongren and Xincheng and pressed toward Pingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he routed rebels at Chongren and Xincheng and advanced toward Pingyuan.

sentences.zh: 會多隆阿卒於軍，都興阿繼督師甘肅，正綰仍奉命為副。

translations.literal: When Duo Longa died in camp, Duxing'a succeeded him as commander in Gansu, and Zhengwan remained under orders as his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: When Duo Longa died in the field, Duxing'a succeeded him as commander in Gansu, and Zhengwan continued to serve as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 克平涼，斬賊首鐵酉、羽輕林，賜黃馬褂。

translations.literal: Pingliang was recovered and the rebel chiefs Tiexi and Yuqinglin were beheaded; he was awarded a yellow riding jacket.
translations.idiomatic: He recovered Pingliang and beheaded the rebel chiefs Tiexi and Yuqinglin, and was awarded a yellow riding jacket.

sentences.zh: 於是固原踞賊悉竄龍山鎮，追擊敗之。

translations.literal: The rebels entrenched at Guyuan then all fled to Longshan Town, where they were pursued and defeated.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels holding Guyuan thereupon all fled to Longshan Town, where Zhengwan pursued and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 賊回竄，又陷固原。

translations.literal: The rebels doubled back and Guyuan fell again.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels turned back, and Guyuan was lost once more.

sentences.zh: 正綰疾趨蓮花城，欲襲其巢穴，遇伏，受矛傷，部下亡千餘人，裹創攻蓮花城，克之，詔嘉其勇。

translations.literal: Zhengwan hastened to Lianhua City intending to strike their lair, met an ambush, was wounded by a spear, and lost more than a thousand men; binding his wounds he assaulted Lianhua City, took it, and the court praised his bravery.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengwan rushed to Lianhua City to strike their stronghold, walked into an ambush, and was wounded by a spear; more than a thousand of his men perished. He bound his wounds, stormed Lianhua City, and took it, and the court commended his valor.

sentences.zh: 四年春，克固原，進攻黑城子，斬賊首黑虎。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year Guyuan was recovered; he advanced against Heichengzi and beheaded the rebel chief Heihu.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fourth year he recovered Guyuan, advanced against Heichengzi, and beheaded the rebel chief Heihu.

sentences.zh: 克官橋、李旺二堡，擒賊首木棍等。

translations.literal: He took the forts of Guanqiao and Liwang and captured rebel chiefs including Mugun.
translations.idiomatic: He captured the forts of Guanqiao and Liwang and seized rebel chiefs including Mugun.

sentences.zh: 乘勝薄預望城，破下馬關、半​​角城賊壘，進規靈州，分兵解安定圍。

translations.literal: Pressing the victory he approached Yuwang City, stormed rebel stockades at Xiamaguan and Banjiao City, advanced against Lingzhou, and detached troops to raise the siege of Anding.
translations.idiomatic: Following up his victory he pressed on Yuwang City, broke rebel stockades at Xiamaguan and Banjiao City, advanced against Lingzhou, and sent detachments to lift the siege of Anding.

sentences.zh: 七月，偕曹克忠攻金積堡，軍餉不繼，為賊所圍，飢潰。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, together with Cao Kezhong he attacked Jinjibao; supplies failed, they were surrounded by rebels, and the army broke up from hunger.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he joined Cao Kezhong in attacking Jinjibao. Provisions ran out, the army was surrounded by rebels, and the troops broke up from starvation.

sentences.zh: 正綰自劾，褫勇號、黃馬褂，黜幫辦，歸總督楊岳斌節制。

translations.literal: Zhengwan memorialized against himself; his brave title and yellow jacket were stripped, his assistant command was removed, and he was placed under the control of Governor-General Yang Yuebin.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengwan submitted a memorial of self-accusation. His brave title and yellow jacket were stripped, his post as assistant commander was removed, and he was placed under Governor-General Yang Yuebin.

sentences.zh: 正綰弟總兵雷恆及副將李高啟等以主將失職，煽亂，犯涇州，正綰不能制止，憤欲自裁。

translations.literal: Zhengwan's younger brother, brigade general Lei Heng, and deputy generals Li Gaoqi and others, citing the commander's dereliction, incited mutiny and attacked Jingzhou; Zhengwan could not stop them and in grief wished to take his own life.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengwan's younger brother, brigade general Lei Heng, together with deputy generals Li Gaoqi and others, citing their commander's failure of duty, incited mutiny and attacked Jingzhou. Zhengwan could not restrain them and in despair wished to kill himself.

sentences.zh: 詔念前功，不加罪，責令整軍勦賊圖自贖。

translations.literal: The court, mindful of his former merit, imposed no punishment and ordered him to reorganize his troops and suppress rebels to redeem himself.
translations.idiomatic: The court, recalling his earlier achievements, imposed no penalty and ordered him to reorganize his army, suppress the rebels, and win back his honor.

sentences.zh: 命巡撫趙長齡會楊岳斌按訊，正綰縛送雷恆等置之法。

translations.literal: Governor Zhao Changling was ordered to join Yang Yuebin in conducting an inquiry; Zhengwan bound Lei Heng and the others and sent them for punishment.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Governor Zhao Changling to join Yang Yuebin in investigating the affair; Zhengwan bound Lei Heng and the others and handed them over for punishment.

sentences.zh: 當事變初起，謠諑紛淆，詔斥劉蓉張皇妄奏，許正綰專摺奏事以慰之。

translations.literal: When the affair first broke out, rumors and slander were confused; the court denounced Liu Rong's alarmist false reports and allowed Zhengwan to submit memorials on his own authority to reassure him.
translations.idiomatic: At the outset of the crisis rumors and accusations flew in every direction; the court rebuked Liu Rong for his alarmist and unfounded memorials and permitted Zhengwan to file memorials directly to reassure him.

sentences.zh: 所部招集增募僅三千人。

translations.literal: His command, through recruitment and enlistment, numbered only about three thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: Through recruitment his command mustered only about three thousand men.

sentences.zh: 五年，蘭州兵變，回匪窺伺，正綰支拄於平涼、固原之間，破賊於橫河川，克平涼，复黃馬褂、勇號。

translations.literal: In the fifth year the Lanzhou garrison mutinied and Muslim rebels watched for openings; Zhengwan held the line between Pingliang and Guyuan, defeated rebels at Henghechuan, recovered Pingliang, and regained his yellow jacket and brave title.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year the Lanzhou troops mutinied while Muslim rebels watched for their chance. Zhengwan braced the frontier between Pingliang and Guyuan, defeated rebels at Henghechuan, recovered Pingliang, and had his yellow jacket and brave title restored.

sentences.zh: 六年，左宗​​棠入陝督師，正綰率軍助剿，援慶陽。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Zuo Zongtang entered Shaanxi to command the campaign; Zhengwan led troops to assist in suppression and relieved Qingyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Zuo Zongtang entered Shaanxi to take command of the campaign; Zhengwan led his army to assist in the suppression and relieved Qingyang.

sentences.zh: 七年，兩破賊於長武，克黃家堡。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he twice defeated rebels at Changwu and took Huangjiabao.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he twice defeated rebels in Changwu district and captured Huangjiabao.

sentences.zh: 八年，會攻董志原，克之，晉號達春巴圖魯。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he joined the assault on Dongzhiyuan, took it, and was advanced in title to Dachun Baturu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he took part in the assault on Dongzhiyuan, captured it, and was advanced in title to Dachun Baturu.

sentences.zh: 又破白彥虎於李旺堡。

translations.literal: He also defeated Bai Yanhu at Liwangbao.
translations.idiomatic: He also routed Bai Yanhu at Liwangbao.

sentences.zh: 會攻金積堡，當西路，屢克要隘，合圍。

translations.literal: In the joint attack on Jinjibao he held the western line, repeatedly captured key passes, and completed the encirclement.
translations.idiomatic: In the joint attack on Jinjibao he held the western approach, repeatedly seized vital passes, and helped close the ring around the fortress.

sentences.zh: 及馬化隆伏誅，被優敘。

translations.literal: When Ma Hualong was executed he received preferential commendation.
translations.idiomatic: After Ma Hualong was put to death, Zhengwan received special commendation for his service.

sentences.zh: 光緒十年，法越兵事起，命率甘軍駐鳳凰城，固邊防，事定回任。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Guangxu, when hostilities broke out between China and France over Vietnam, he was ordered to lead Gansu troops to garrison Fenghuangcheng to secure the frontier; when affairs were settled he returned to his post.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Guangxu (1884), when war broke out between China and France, he was ordered to lead Gansu troops to garrison Fenghuangcheng on the frontier. When the crisis passed he returned to his regular duties.

sentences.zh: 兩遇萬壽慶典，加太子少保、尚書銜。

translations.literal: On two occasions of imperial longevity celebrations he was given the ranks of Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On two imperial longevity celebrations he was granted the ranks of Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and Minister.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，循化撒回倡亂，督剿無功，革職留任。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year the Salar Muslims of Xunhua rose in rebellion; though he directed suppression he achieved nothing and was dismissed from office but retained on duty.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year the Salar Muslims of Xunhua rose in revolt. Though he directed the campaign he won no success and was stripped of office yet kept on duty.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，罷，卒於家，仍以前勞賜卹。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year he was removed from office; he died at home and was still granted posthumous honors for his earlier service.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year he was dismissed. He died at home and was still granted posthumous honors in recognition of his earlier achievements.

sentences.zh: 陶茂林，湖南長沙人。

translations.literal: Tao Maolin was a native of Changsha, Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Tao Maolin came from Changsha in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 以武童入湘軍，轉戰湖北、江西，積功至游擊。

translations.literal: Entering the Xiang Army as a military licentiate, he fought through Hubei and Jiangxi and rose through merit to colonel.
translations.idiomatic: He entered the Xiang Army as a military licentiate, campaigned through Hubei and Jiangxi, and rose through merit to colonel.

sentences.zh: 咸豐八年，胡林翼調為楚軍營官，扼黃州，破賊霍山、舒城，克建德，擢參將。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Xianfeng, Hu Lin'yi transferred him as a Chu Army battalion officer to hold Huangzhou; he defeated rebels at Huoshan and Shucheng, took Jiande, and was promoted to regimental commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Xianfeng Hu Lin'yi assigned him as a Chu Army battalion officer to hold Huangzhou. He defeated rebels at Huoshan and Shucheng, captured Jiande, and was promoted to regimental commander.

sentences.zh: 十年，從多隆阿破賊於桐城掛車河，擢副將。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he followed Duo Longa in defeating rebels at Guache River in Tongcheng and was promoted to deputy general.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he followed Duo Longa in defeating rebels at Guache River near Tongcheng and was promoted to deputy general.

sentences.zh: 十一年，破賊施家山，擒其渠，及克安慶，賜號鍾勇巴圖魯。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he defeated rebels at Shijiashan and captured their leader; when Anqing fell he was granted the title Zhongyong Baturu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he routed rebels at Shijiashan and captured their chieftain. When Anqing was taken he was granted the title Zhongyong Baturu.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，克廬州，先登，以總兵記名。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi Luzhou was taken — he was first over the wall — and he was enrolled by name as brigade general.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi he was first over the wall when Luzhou fell and was placed on the rolls as brigade general.

sentences.zh: 遂從多隆阿西征，破賊於武關。

translations.literal: He then followed Duo Longa on the western expedition and defeated rebels at Wuguan.
translations.idiomatic: He then followed Duo Longa on the western expedition and defeated rebels at Wuguan.

sentences.zh: 從剿回匪，解同州圍。

translations.literal: In suppressing Muslim rebels he helped raise the siege of Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: While suppressing Muslim rebels he helped lift the siege of Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 克羌白鎮、王閣村賊巢，功皆最，授漢中鎮總兵。

translations.literal: He took the rebel nests at Qiangbai Town and Wangge Village; his achievements were foremost in every case, and he was appointed brigade general of Hanzhong Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: He stormed the rebel strongholds at Qiangbai Town and Wangge Village, his merit ranking first in every engagement, and was appointed brigade general of Hanzhong Garrison.

sentences.zh: 鳳翔被圍久，茂林率三千人往援，連戰解圍，擢甘肅提督。

translations.literal: Fengxiang had been besieged for a long time; Maolin led three thousand men to relieve it, won successive battles to lift the siege, and was promoted to Gansu provincial military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Fengxiang had long been under siege. Maolin led three thousand men to its relief, won battle after battle until the siege was raised, and was promoted to Gansu provincial military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 粵匪出寶雞山口，擾郿縣、盩厔，茂林要擊雨門鎮、二嶺關，迭敗之。

translations.literal: Taiping rebels issued from Baoji Pass to harry Mei County and Zhouzhi; Maolin intercepted them at Yumen Town and Erling Pass and repeatedly defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Taiping rebels poured through Baoji Pass to raid Mei County and Zhouzhi. Maolin intercepted them at Yumen Town and Erling Pass and defeated them again and again.

sentences.zh: 進克汧陽、隴州。

translations.literal: He advanced and took Qianyang and Longzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He pressed forward and captured Qianyang and Longzhou.

sentences.zh: 遂會雷正綰分道規平涼，陣斬賊首木仲沅訥三等，克之，賜黃馬褂。

translations.literal: He then joined Zhengwan on separate routes to invest Pingliang, slew rebel chiefs including Mu Zhongyuanna and others in battle, took the city, and was awarded a yellow jacket.
translations.idiomatic: He then joined Lei Zhengwan on converging routes against Pingliang, slew rebel chiefs including Mu Zhongyuanna in the field, captured the city, and was awarded a yellow riding jacket.

sentences.zh: 進拔張家川賊巢，破龍山鎮、蓮花城援賊，解安定圍。

translations.literal: He stormed the rebel nest at Zhangjiachuan, broke relieving rebels at Longshan Town and Lianhua City, and raised the siege of Anding.
translations.idiomatic: He stormed the rebel nest at Zhangjiachuan, routed relieving forces at Longshan Town and Lianhua City, and lifted the siege of Anding.

sentences.zh: 克金縣，破賊惠城，擒其渠黑牙古。

translations.literal: He took Jin County, broke the rebel camp at Huicheng, and captured the bandit chief Heiyagu.
translations.idiomatic: He captured Jin County, smashed the rebel camp at Huicheng, and seized the bandit chief Heiyagu.

sentences.zh: 四年，克黑城賊巢，解靖遠圍。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he took the rebel nest at Heicheng and raised the siege of Jingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he took the rebel stronghold at Heicheng and relieved Jingyuan.

sentences.zh: 進攻會寧，所部索餉譁潰五營，賊乘之，六營皆陷。

translations.literal: Advancing to attack Huining, five battalions of his command mutinied over pay and dispersed; the rebels seized the moment and six battalions were lost.
translations.idiomatic: As he advanced on Huining, five of his battalions mutinied over unpaid wages and scattered. The rebels seized the opportunity and six battalions were overrun.

sentences.zh: 茂林調後路四營來援，突圍出，退駐安定。

translations.literal: Maolin called up four rear battalions to help, broke out of encirclement, and withdrew to Anding.
translations.idiomatic: Maolin summoned four rear battalions to his aid, fought his way out of encirclement, and fell back to Anding.

sentences.zh: 巡撫劉蓉疏陳甘軍積弊，論茂林不職，茂林亦以兵潰自劾。

translations.literal: Governor Liu Rong memorialized on the longstanding abuses of the Gansu Army and judged Maolin unfit for command; Maolin also memorialized against himself over the troop collapse.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Liu Rong memorialized on the deep-seated abuses of the Gansu Army and held Maolin unfit for command. Maolin likewise submitted a memorial of self-accusation over the collapse of his troops.

sentences.zh: 詔斥廢法營私，以致兵潰而叛，遂罷職，歸。

translations.literal: The court condemned him for violating regulations and enriching himself privately, which had led to the mutiny and revolt, and he was dismissed and returned home.
translations.idiomatic: The court condemned him for breaking regulations and lining his own pockets, which had caused the troops to mutiny and rebel. He was dismissed and sent home.

sentences.zh: 十年，貴州巡撫曾璧光調茂林赴黔協剿。

translations.literal: In the tenth year Guizhou Governor Zeng Biguang summoned Maolin to Guizhou to assist in suppression.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year Guizhou Governor Zeng Biguang called Maolin to Guizhou to assist in the campaign.

sentences.zh: 復新城，克安順賊巢，平古州、丹江苗，復原官。

translations.literal: He recovered Xincheng, took the rebel nest at Anshun, pacified the Miao of Guzhou and Danjiang, and was restored to his original office.
translations.idiomatic: He recovered Xincheng, stormed the rebel nest at Anshun, pacified the Miao of Guzhou and Danjiang, and was restored to his former rank.

sentences.zh: 光緒二年，收復下江、永從各城，破六峒賊巢，加頭品頂戴，晉號愛星阿巴圖魯。

translations.literal: In the second year of Guangxu he recovered the cities of Xialiu and Yongcong, broke the rebel nest at Liudong, was given a first-class official's cap button, and was advanced to Aixing'a Baturu.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Guangxu he recovered the cities of Xialiu and Yongcong, destroyed the rebel nest at Liudong, was given a first-class cap button, and was advanced in title to Aixing'a Baturu.

sentences.zh: 十六年，署古州鎮總兵，卒於官。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he served as acting brigade general of Guzhou Garrison and died in office.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he served as acting brigade general of Guzhou Garrison and died in office.

sentences.zh: 曹克忠，直隸天津人。

translations.literal: Cao Kezhong was a native of Tianjin, Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Kezhong came from Tianjin in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 初投效湘軍，嗣從多隆阿，積功至都司。

translations.literal: He first enlisted in the Xiang Army, later followed Duo Longa, and rose through merit to battalion commander.
translations.idiomatic: He first enlisted with the Xiang Army, later served under Duo Longa, and rose through merit to battalion commander.

sentences.zh: 咸豐十年，令募五百人為忠字營，大破援賊於潛山、太湖，洊擢參將，賜號悍勇巴圖魯。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Xianfeng he was ordered to raise five hundred men for the Zhongzi Battalion; he heavily defeated relieving rebels at Qianshan and Taihu, was repeatedly promoted to regimental commander, and was granted the title Hanyong Baturu.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Xianfeng he was ordered to raise five hundred men for the Zhongzi Battalion. He inflicted a crushing defeat on relieving rebels at Qianshan and Taihu, was promoted in succession to regimental commander, and was granted the title Hanyong Baturu.

sentences.zh: 掛車河之捷，擢副將。

translations.literal: For the victory at Guache River he was promoted to deputy general.
translations.idiomatic: For the victory at Guache River he was promoted to deputy general.

sentences.zh: 克桐城、宿松諸城，以總兵記名。

translations.literal: He took Tongcheng, Susong, and other cities and was enrolled by name as brigade general.
translations.idiomatic: He captured Tongcheng, Susong, and other cities and was placed on the rolls as brigade general.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，克廬州。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi Luzhou was taken.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi he took part in the capture of Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 後從多隆阿西征，武關、同州諸戰皆從。

translations.literal: Later he followed Duo Longa on the western expedition and took part in the battles at Wuguan and Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Later he followed Duo Longa on the western expedition and fought at Wuguan, Tongzhou, and other engagements.

sentences.zh: 二年，攻羌白鎮，克忠單騎往諭賊，賊請降，察其詐，潛師會攻，下之，乘勝奪王閣村，予一品封典。

translations.literal: In the second year, attacking Qiangbai Town, Kezhong rode alone to parley with the rebels; they asked to surrender, but seeing through their deceit he secretly brought up troops for a joint assault, took the place, pressed the success to seize Wangge Village, and was granted a second-rank fief privilege.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, attacking Qiangbai Town, Kezhong rode out alone to address the rebels. They offered to surrender, but discerning their treachery he secretly massed troops for a coordinated assault, took the town, pressed on to seize Wangge Village, and was granted a second-rank fief privilege.

sentences.zh: 尋率烏拉馬隊及楚勇七營屯長安、鄠縣之間。

translations.literal: Soon he led a Ulan cavalry detachment and seven Chu Army battalions stationed between Chang'an and Hu County.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he led a Ulan cavalry detachment and seven Chu Army battalions, encamped between Chang'an and Hu County.

sentences.zh: 光泰廟為入省要衝，賊踞之以扼糧路，克忠擊走之。

translations.literal: Guangtai Temple was a vital pass into the province; rebels held it to choke the grain route, and Kezhong drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: Guangtai Temple was the key gateway into the province. Rebels held it to choke the supply route, and Kezhong drove them away.

sentences.zh: 分隊清西路餘匪，省城始安。

translations.literal: Detached columns cleared remaining bandits on the western route and the provincial capital was finally secure.
translations.idiomatic: Detached columns swept the remaining bandits from the western route, and the provincial capital was at last secure.

sentences.zh: 以提督記名，授河州鎮總兵。

translations.literal: He was enrolled by name as provincial military commissioner and appointed brigade general of Hezhou Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: He was placed on the rolls as provincial military commissioner and appointed brigade general of Hezhou Garrison.

sentences.zh: 渡渭連破賊於白起營、馬家埠、白吉原，邠州平，陝回西趨。

translations.literal: Crossing the Wei he defeated rebels in succession at Baiqiying, Majiabu, and Baijiyuan; Binzhou was pacified and the Shaanxi Muslims moved west.
translations.idiomatic: Crossing the Wei River he defeated rebels in succession at Baiqiying, Majiabu, and Baijiyuan. Binzhou was pacified and the Shaanxi Muslims drove westward.

sentences.zh: 三年，平麟游諸匪。

translations.literal: In the third year he pacified the bandits of Linyou and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he pacified the bandits throughout Linyou and neighboring districts.

sentences.zh: 會援甘肅，連破賊於西河口、黑水峪，赴河州本任。

translations.literal: He joined the relief of Gansu, defeated rebels in succession at Xihekou and Heishuiyu, and proceeded to his regular post at Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: He joined the relief of Gansu, won successive victories at Xihekou and Heishuiyu, and proceeded to his regular post at Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 克秦安，解秦州圍，賜黃馬褂。

translations.literal: He took Qin'an, lifted the siege of Qinzhou, and was awarded a yellow jacket.
translations.idiomatic: He captured Qin'an, lifted the siege of Qinzhou, and was awarded a yellow riding jacket.

sentences.zh: 四年，攻蕭何城及馬定嘴，將台、隆德諸堡，悉平。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he attacked Xiaohe City, Madingzui, Jiangtai, Longde, and other forts, all of which were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he attacked Xiaohe City, Madingzui, Jiangtai, Longde, and other strongholds, and all were pacified.

sentences.zh: 克海城，回匪並竄李旺堡、同心城，攻下之。

translations.literal: Haicheng was taken; Muslim rebels massed at Liwangbao and Tongxincheng, which were then stormed and taken.
translations.idiomatic: He took Haicheng. Muslim rebels massed at Liwangbao and Tongxincheng, and he stormed and captured both.

sentences.zh: 偕雷正綰規取金積堡，屯強家沙窩，數有斬獲。

translations.literal: With Zhengwan he planned to take Jinjibao and encamped at Qiangjiashawo with repeated kills.
translations.idiomatic: Together with Lei Zhengwan he planned the capture of Jinjibao, encamped at Qiangjiashawo, and won repeated victories.

sentences.zh: 輕進，為賊所包鈔，正綰軍先潰，克忠亦退。

translations.literal: Advancing recklessly he was enveloped by rebels; Zhengwan's army broke first and Kezhong also withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing too boldly he was surrounded by rebels. Zhengwan's army broke first, and Kezhong withdrew as well.

sentences.zh: 因前功免罪，授甘肅提督。

translations.literal: Because of his earlier achievements he was spared punishment and appointed Gansu provincial military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In view of his earlier achievements he was spared punishment and appointed Gansu provincial military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 時陶茂林、雷正綰軍相繼譁變，回氛益熾，自楊岳斌楚軍外，僅克忠一軍與之相持。

translations.literal: At that time the armies of Tao Maolin and Lei Zhengwan mutinied in turn and the Muslim rebellion flared hotter; apart from Yang Yuebin's Chu Army, only Kezhong's force still held them in check.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the armies of Tao Maolin and Lei Zhengwan mutinied one after another and the Muslim rebellion burned hotter than ever. Apart from Yang Yuebin's Chu Army, only Kezhong's force still held the line against the rebels.

sentences.zh: 克忠援鞏昌，賊敗走，又毀董家堡賊巢。

translations.literal: Kezhong relieved Gongchang; the rebels were beaten and fled, and he destroyed the rebel nest at Dongjiabao.
translations.idiomatic: Kezhong relieved Gongchang. The rebels were routed and fled, and he destroyed the rebel nest at Dongjiabao.

sentences.zh: 五年，援洮州，次李岐山，回目馬芳乞降，誅其酋丁重選等而還。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he relieved Taozhou, camped at Li Qishan; Muslim leader Ma Fang begged to surrender and Kezhong executed chiefs including Ding Chongxuan and returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he marched to relieve Taozhou and encamped at Li Qishan. The Muslim leader Ma Fang begged to surrender; Kezhong executed chiefs including Ding Chongxuan and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 蘭州標兵變，楊岳斌令克忠移軍鎮懾。

translations.literal: The standard troops of Lanzhou mutinied; Yang Yuebin ordered Kezhong to move his army to awe them.
translations.idiomatic: The standard battalions of Lanzhou mutinied. Yang Yuebin ordered Kezhong to move his army there to overawe them.

sentences.zh: 克忠至，人心稍定，然糧餉俱竭，乞病回籍。

translations.literal: When Kezhong arrived morale steadied somewhat, but provisions were wholly exhausted and he pleaded illness to return home.
translations.idiomatic: When Kezhong arrived the people's hearts steadied somewhat, but provisions were wholly exhausted. He pleaded illness and returned to his native place.

sentences.zh: 十年，詔起赴陝接統淮軍，專防肅州。

translations.literal: In the tenth year an edict recalled him to Shaanxi to take command of the Huai Army and defend Suzhou exclusively.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year an edict recalled him to Shaanxi to take command of the Huai Army and hold Suzhou as his sole responsibility.

sentences.zh: 十一年，所部有結會匪者，甘軍馬世俊騎兵亦變，降捻多叛應，克忠遣兵平之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year some in his command joined secret societies; Gansu cavalry under Ma Shijun also mutinied, and many surrendered Nian bandits rebelled in response; Kezhong sent troops to put them down.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year some of his troops joined secret societies, the Gansu cavalry under Ma Shijun also mutinied, and many surrendered Nian bandits rose in response. Kezhong sent troops to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 复乞病解軍事。

translations.literal: He again pleaded illness and relinquished military duties.
translations.idiomatic: He again pleaded illness and resigned his military command.

sentences.zh: 十一年，署甘肅提督，尋解職歸。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he served as acting Gansu provincial military commissioner and soon resigned and returned home.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he served as acting Gansu provincial military commissioner, then soon resigned and returned home.

sentences.zh: 光緒九年，命募六營防山海關。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Guangxu he was ordered to raise six battalions to guard Shanhaiguan.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Guangxu he was ordered to raise six battalions to guard Shanhaiguan.

sentences.zh: 十年，授廣東水師提督。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was appointed provincial military commissioner of the Guangdong Navy.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was appointed provincial military commissioner of the Guangdong Navy.

sentences.zh: 十一年，病罷，食全俸。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was dismissed for illness but drew full salary.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was dismissed on grounds of illness but continued to draw full salary.

sentences.zh: 二十年，命治天津團練，統津勝軍。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he was ordered to organize militia training at Tianjin and commanded the Jinsheng Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he was ordered to organize militia training at Tianjin and took command of the Jinsheng Army.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，卒，賜卹。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year he died and posthumous honors were granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year he died and posthumous honors were granted.

sentences.zh: 胡中和，字元廷，湖南湘鄉人。

translations.literal: Hu Zhonghe, styled Yuanting, was a native of Xiangxiang, Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Zhonghe, whose style was Yuanting, came from Xiangxiang in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 咸豐初，從湘軍剿粵匪，積功擢把總。

translations.literal: In the early Xianfeng years he joined the Xiang Army to suppress the Taiping rebels and through merit was promoted to platoon officer.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Xianfeng years he joined the Xiang Army to suppress the Taiping rebels and through accumulated merit was promoted to platoon officer.

sentences.zh: 六年，從蕭啟江援江西，复袁州，超擢都司，賜花翎。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he followed Xiao Qijiang to relieve Jiangxi, recovered Yuanzhou, was specially promoted to battalion commander, and was given a peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he followed Xiao Qijiang to relieve Jiangxi, recovered Yuanzhou, was specially promoted to battalion commander, and was awarded a peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 七年，從克臨安，中砲傷，以游擊留湖南補用。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he followed in the capture of Lin'an, was wounded by cannon fire, and was retained in Hunan for appointment as colonel.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he took part in capturing Lin'an, was struck by cannon fire, and was kept in Hunan for appointment as colonel.

sentences.zh: 八年，破賊上屯渡，乘勝复撫州，擢參將。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he defeated rebels at Shangtundu, pressed the victory to recover Fuzhou, and was promoted to regimental commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he routed rebels at Shangtundu, followed up to recover Fuzhou, and was promoted to regimental commander.

sentences.zh: 九年，复南安，擢副將。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he recovered Nan'an and was promoted to deputy general.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he recovered Nan'an and was promoted to deputy general.

sentences.zh: 石達開由寶慶竄廣西，陷興安，遣黨攻桂林，自率悍賊屯大溶江。

translations.literal: Shi Dakai fled from Baoding into Guangxi, took Xing'an, sent partisans to attack Guilin, and himself led fierce rebels to encamp at Darong River.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Dakai broke out from Baoding into Guangxi, seized Xing'an, dispatched followers to attack Guilin, and personally led his fiercest troops to camp on the Darong River.

sentences.zh: 中和從蕭啟江往援，大破賊於大溶江，賊竄貴州境，加總兵銜，賜號伊德克勒巴圖魯。

translations.literal: Zhonghe followed Xiao Qijiang to the relief, inflicted a great defeat on the rebels at Darong River, and the rebels fled into Guizhou; he was given the rank of brigade general and granted the title Yidekele Baturu.
translations.idiomatic: Zhonghe followed Xiao Qijiang to the rescue and routed the rebels at Darong River. The rebels fled into Guizhou territory. He was given brigade-general rank and the title Yidekele Baturu.

sentences.zh: 十年，蕭啟江率軍援四川，中和從之。

translations.literal: In the tenth year Xiao Qijiang led troops to relieve Sichuan and Zhonghe followed him.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year Xiao Qijiang led an army to relieve Sichuan, and Zhonghe went with him.

sentences.zh: 啟江卒於軍，中和偕何勝必、蕭慶高等分領其眾。

translations.literal: When Qijiang died in the field, Zhonghe together with He Shengbi, Xiao Qinggao, and others divided command of his forces.
translations.idiomatic: When Qijiang died in camp, Zhonghe joined He Shengbi, Xiao Qinggao, and others in dividing command of his army.

sentences.zh: 剿滇匪李永和於井研，連戰皆捷，賊解圍遁，以總兵記名。

translations.literal: In suppressing the Yunnan rebel Li Yonghe at Jingyan he won battle after battle; the rebels raised the siege and fled, and he was enrolled by name as brigade general.
translations.idiomatic: While suppressing the Yunnan rebel Li Yonghe at Jingyan he won every engagement. The rebels broke off the siege and fled, and he was placed on the rolls as brigade general.

sentences.zh: 尋授四川建昌鎮總兵。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was appointed brigade general of Jianchang Garrison in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed brigade general of Jianchang Garrison in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 十一年，永和竄踞富順牛腹渡，兩岸築堅壘，背水而陣。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Yonghe entrenched himself at Niufudu in Fushun, building strong forts on both banks of the river and drawing up his line with the water at his back.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year Yonghe held Niufudu in Fushun, fortifying both banks of the river and forming his battle line with the water behind him.

sentences.zh: 中和選銳卒沿河設伏，自率羸師誘之，賊大出，伏發，截其歸路，俘斬無算，賊壘盡夷，進解大邑之圍，予二品封典。

translations.literal: Zhonghe selected crack troops and set an ambush along the river, himself leading a weak force to lure the enemy. The rebels came out in force; the ambush sprang, their retreat was cut off, and countless were captured or slain. The rebel forts were utterly destroyed, the siege of Dayi was raised, and he was granted a second-rank fief privilege.
translations.idiomatic: Zhonghe posted elite troops in ambush along the river and led a depleted force forward as bait. The rebels poured out; the ambush struck, their line of retreat was severed, and the slaughter was immense. Every rebel fort was leveled, the siege of Dayi was lifted, and he received a second-rank fief privilege.

sentences.zh: 駱秉章督師蒞蜀，檄中和偕緒軍援綿州。

translations.literal: When Luo Bingzhang arrived in Sichuan to take command, he ordered Zhonghe to join the relief army for Mianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Luo Bingzhang came to Sichuan as commander-in-chief, he ordered Zhonghe to march with the relief forces to Mianzhou.

sentences.zh: 滇匪藍朝柱在諸賊中最狡悍，圍綿州日久。

translations.literal: Among all the rebels the Yunnan bandit Lan Chaozhu was the most cunning and fierce; he had besieged Mianzhou for a long time.
translations.idiomatic: Of all the rebel leaders the Yunnan bandit Lan Chaozhu was the craftiest and most formidable, and he had kept Mianzhou under siege for a long time.

sentences.zh: 軍至，連破之，圍始解，又敗之西山觀。

translations.literal: When the army arrived it defeated him again and again; the siege was finally raised, and he was beaten again at Xishanguan.
translations.idiomatic: When the army arrived it routed him in successive battles, the siege was at last raised, and he was defeated again at Xishanguan.

sentences.zh: 朝柱竄丹棱，與李永和合攻眉州。

translations.literal: Chaozhu fled to Danling and joined Li Yonghe in attacking Meizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Chaozhu fled to Danling and united with Li Yonghe to attack Meizhou.

sentences.zh: 中和馳援，賊分路來撲，中和突陣，矛傷顋，血殷衣，不顧，奮擊破之，解眉州圍。

translations.literal: Zhonghe rushed to the relief. The rebels came at him from several directions; he charged the line, was wounded in the cheek by a spear, blood soaking his garments, yet paid no heed and fought on until the rebels were broken and the siege of Meizhou was raised.
translations.idiomatic: Zhonghe galloped to the rescue. The rebels assailed him from several routes; he burst through the formation, took a spear wound in the cheek until his clothes ran with blood, yet fought on without pause until the enemy broke and the siege of Meizhou was lifted.

sentences.zh: 進攻丹棱，朝柱遁走，復其城，以提督記名。

translations.literal: He advanced on Danling; Chaozhu fled, the city was recovered, and he was enrolled by name as provincial military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He pressed the attack on Danling. Chaozhu fled, the city was recovered, and he was placed on the rolls as provincial military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，擢雲南提督。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he was promoted to Yunnan provincial military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi he was promoted to Yunnan provincial military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 李永和自眉州敗後，竄踞青神，諸軍進剿，數敗之，永和遁犍為龍場，負嵎死抗。

translations.literal: After his defeat at Meizhou, Li Yonghe entrenched himself at Qingshen. The allied armies advanced against him and defeated him repeatedly; Yonghe fled to Longchang in Qianwei and made a desperate stand.
translations.idiomatic: After his defeat at Meizhou, Li Yonghe held Qingshen. The allied armies pressed the campaign and defeated him again and again until Yonghe fled to Longchang in Qianwei, where he fought to the death from his last redoubt.

sentences.zh: 中和圍之，壘石牆，編木柵，外浚深壕，密布梅花椿。

translations.literal: Zhonghe invested the place, building stone walls, weaving wooden palisades, digging deep moats outside, and planting rows of chevaux-de-frise.
translations.idiomatic: Zhonghe besieged the position, throwing up stone walls, weaving wooden stockades, digging deep trenches around them, and planting dense rows of abatis.

sentences.zh: 賊知必死，突攻蕭慶高營，中和截擊，敗退，連戰七日。

translations.literal: Knowing they could not escape, the rebels made a sortie against Xiao Qinggao's camp; Zhonghe intercepted them and drove them back after seven days of fighting.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels, knowing death was certain, stormed Xiao Qinggao's camp. Zhonghe intercepted them and beat them back after seven days of fighting.

sentences.zh: 賊伏不出，乃使降賊譚仁曲持書約降，期會於豬市坡，預伏兵賊巢旁。

translations.literal: The rebels lay hidden and would not come out, so he had the surrendered rebel Tan Renqu carry a letter offering terms, with a rendezvous set at Zhushipo and troops pre-positioned beside the rebel nest.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels kept to cover and would not emerge, so he sent the surrendered rebel Tan Renqu with a letter proposing surrender, fixing a meeting at Zhushipo while troops lay in wait beside the rebel stronghold.

sentences.zh: 永和與其黨卯得興數十騎來會，伏起分攻，焚其巢。

translations.literal: Yonghe came to the meeting with several dozen horsemen including his follower Mao Dexing; the ambush rose and attacked from two sides, burning the nest.
translations.idiomatic: Yonghe arrived for the parley with several dozen horsemen including his follower Mao Dexing. The ambush sprang and attacked from both sides, setting the nest ablaze.

sentences.zh: 永和、得興駭奔，追擒之，降其眾五千。

translations.literal: Yonghe and Dexing fled in panic; pursued and captured, they surrendered five thousand followers.
translations.idiomatic: Yonghe and Dexing fled in terror, were pursued and captured, and five thousand of their followers surrendered.

sentences.zh: 詔嘉中和運籌決勝，生擒渠魁，賜黃馬褂。

translations.literal: The court commended Zhonghe for planning the victory and capturing the rebel chiefs alive, and awarded him a yellow riding jacket.
translations.idiomatic: The court praised Zhonghe for devising the stratagem that won the day and taking the rebel chiefs alive, and granted him a yellow riding jacket.

sentences.zh: 石達開擾蜀邊，中和偕蕭慶高、何勝必合擊於橫江，走之。

translations.literal: When Shi Dakai harassed the Sichuan border, Zhonghe together with Xiao Qinggao and He Shengbi joined forces to attack him at Hengjiang and drive him off.
translations.idiomatic: When Shi Dakai raided the Sichuan frontier, Zhonghe joined Xiao Qinggao and He Shengbi in a combined attack at Hengjiang and drove him away.

sentences.zh: 二年春，達開復分路犯蜀，自率大隊數万由米糧壩渡金沙江。

translations.literal: In the spring of the second year Dakai again invaded Sichuan by several routes; he himself led a host of tens of thousands across the Jinsha River at Miliangba.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the second year Dakai again invaded Sichuan on multiple fronts, personally leading a force of tens of thousands across the Jinsha River at Miliangba.

sentences.zh: 中和督軍扼化林坪、瀘定橋，擊破之，賊走工卩部土司山中，達開旋就擒。

translations.literal: Zhonghe directed the army to hold Hualinping and Luding Bridge, defeated the rebels, and they fled into the mountains of the Gongbu tribal territory; Dakai was soon captured.
translations.idiomatic: Zhonghe directed the army to block Hualinping and Luding Bridge, broke the rebels, and drove them into the mountains of the Gongbu tribes. Dakai was captured soon afterward.

sentences.zh: 調四川提督。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Sichuan provincial military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to the post of Sichuan provincial military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 三年，破滇匪於敘永廳。

translations.literal: In the third year he defeated Yunnan rebels at Xuyong Subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he defeated Yunnan rebels in Xuyong Subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 初，李永和既誅，餘黨竄陝西，至是入甘肅，陷階州。

translations.literal: Earlier, after Li Yonghe was executed, his remnant followers had fled to Shaanxi; by this time they entered Gansu and took Jiezhou.
translations.idiomatic: After Li Yonghe was put to death, his remnant followers had fled into Shaanxi; now they entered Gansu and captured Jiezhou.

sentences.zh: 四年，中和偕總兵周達武往剿，毀龍王廟、三官殿賊壘，逼階州城下，掘地道轟城，克之，斬賊酋蔡昌齡，盡殲其黨。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Zhonghe together with brigade general Zhou Dawu marched to suppress them, destroyed the rebel forts at Longwang Temple and Sanguan Hall, pressed to the walls of Jiezhou, dug a mine to blast the walls, took the city, and beheaded the rebel chief Cai Changling, annihilating his entire band.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Zhonghe joined brigade general Zhou Dawu in the campaign, destroyed the rebel forts at Longwang Temple and Sanguan Hall, pressed to the walls of Jiezhou, tunneled under the walls and blew them open, captured the city, beheaded the rebel chief Cai Changling, and wiped out his entire following.

sentences.zh: 階州平，被珍賚。

translations.literal: With Jiezhou pacified he received imperial gifts.
translations.idiomatic: Once Jiezhou was pacified he received imperial gifts of commendation.

sentences.zh: 冬，剿苗匪於建武，腰中彈傷，力戰敗之。

translations.literal: In winter he suppressed Miao bandits at Jianwu, was struck in the waist by a bullet, yet fought on vigorously and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he campaigned against Miao bandits at Jianwu, took a bullet wound in the waist, yet fought fiercely and routed them.

sentences.zh: 五年，剿屏山賊，解馬邊廳圍，誅賊酋宋任傑等，餘匪悉平。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he suppressed bandits at Pingshan, raised the siege of Mabian Subprefecture, executed bandit chiefs including Song Renjie, and the remaining bandits were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he suppressed bandits at Pingshan, lifted the siege of Mabian Subprefecture, executed bandit chiefs including Song Renjie, and the remaining outlaws were all pacified.

sentences.zh: 十三年，調雲南提督。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was transferred to Yunnan provincial military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was transferred to Yunnan provincial military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 光緒二年，抵任。

translations.literal: In the second year of Guangxu he assumed his post.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Guangxu he took up his duties.

sentences.zh: 三年，平騰越夷匪。

translations.literal: In the third year he pacified the Yi bandits of Tengyue.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he pacified the Yi bandits of Tengyue.

sentences.zh: 七年，丁母憂歸里。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, upon his mother's death, he returned home to observe mourning.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, when his mother died, he returned home to observe mourning.

sentences.zh: 九年，卒，賜卹。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he died and posthumous honors were granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he died and posthumous honors were granted.

sentences.zh: 何勝必，湖南湘鄉人。

translations.literal: He Shengbi was a native of Xiangxiang, Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: He Shengbi came from Xiangxiang in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 咸豐中，勝必應募入湘軍，從蕭啟江轉戰江西、廣西，積功至副將。

translations.literal: In the Xianfeng years Shengbi enlisted in the Xiang Army, followed Xiao Qijiang in campaigns through Jiangxi and Guangxi, and rose through merit to deputy general.
translations.idiomatic: During the Xianfeng era Shengbi enlisted in the Xiang Army, followed Xiao Qijiang through Jiangxi and Guangxi, and rose through merit to deputy general.

sentences.zh: 從入蜀，分統湘果右軍，破李永和於井研，又破之於資州，陣斬賊酋王二官，賜號禦勇巴圖魯。

translations.literal: Entering Shu he took command of the right wing of the Xiang Guo Army, defeated Li Yonghe at Jingyan, defeated him again at Zizhou, slew the rebel chief Wang Erguan in battle, and was granted the title Yuyong Baturu.
translations.idiomatic: On entering Sichuan he commanded the right wing of the Xiang Guo Army, defeated Li Yonghe at Jingyan and again at Zizhou, slew the rebel chief Wang Erguan in the field, and was granted the title Yuyong Baturu.

sentences.zh: 十一年，會破滇匪藍朝柱於西山觀，又敗諸青衣壩，解眉州圍，追至青神，擒斬甚眾，授甘肅肅州鎮總兵。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he joined in defeating the Yunnan rebel Lan Chaozhu at Xishanguan, defeated him again at Qingyiba, raised the siege of Meizhou, pursued to Qingshen, and captured or slew a great number; he was appointed brigade general of Suzhou Garrison in Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he helped defeat the Yunnan rebel Lan Chaozhu at Xishanguan, routed him again at Qingyiba, lifted the siege of Meizhou, pursued to Qingshen, and captured or slew a great host. He was appointed brigade general of Suzhou Garrison in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，會諸軍克青神，追賊宜賓，擒賊目周廷光。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he joined the allied armies in taking Qingshen, pursued the rebels to Yibin, and captured the rebel leader Zhou Tingguang.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi he joined the allied armies in capturing Qingshen, pursued the rebels to Yibin, and seized the rebel leader Zhou Tingguang.

sentences.zh: 偕胡中和誘擒李永和於犍為龍場，二年，偕蕭慶高援漢中，戰油坊街，不利，漢中、城固相繼陷，革職留軍。

translations.literal: Together with Hu Zhonghe he lured and captured Li Yonghe at Longchang in Qianwei. In the second year he joined Xiao Qinggao in relieving Hanzhong; at the battle of Youfangjie the engagement went badly, Hanzhong and Chenggu fell in succession, and he was dismissed from office but kept with the army.
translations.idiomatic: Together with Hu Zhonghe he lured Li Yonghe into capture at Longchang in Qianwei. In the second year he joined Xiao Qinggao in relieving Hanzhong. At Youfangjie the battle went badly, Hanzhong and Chenggu fell one after another, and he was stripped of office but kept with the army.

sentences.zh: 三年，會攻法慈院賊壘，再敗之牟家壩，乘勝薄漢中城下，捻渠陳得才遁走，克漢中，復原官。

translations.literal: In the third year he joined the assault on the rebel fort at Faziyuan, defeated the enemy again at Moujiaba, pressed the advantage to the walls of Hanzhong, the Nian chieftain Chen Deicai fled, Hanzhong was taken, and his original rank was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he joined the attack on the rebel fort at Faziyuan, defeated the enemy again at Moujiaba, pressed to the walls of Hanzhong, the Nian leader Chen Deicai fled, Hanzhong was recovered, and his former rank was restored.

sentences.zh: 又破陳得才於上元觀，克城固，進規階州。

translations.literal: He defeated Chen Deicai again at Shangyuanguan, took Chenggu, and advanced to invest Jiezhou.
translations.idiomatic: He routed Chen Deicai again at Shangyuanguan, captured Chenggu, and advanced to besiege Jiezhou.

sentences.zh: 四年，卒於軍，賜卹，諡威愨。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he died in the field; posthumous honors were granted and he was given the posthumous name Weique.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he died in camp. Posthumous honors were granted and he was given the posthumous name Weique.

sentences.zh: 蕭慶高，湖南湘鄉人。

translations.literal: Xiao Qinggao was a native of Xiangxiang, Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Qinggao came from Xiangxiang in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 隸楚軍，積功至副將。

translations.literal: He served in the Chu Army and rose through merit to deputy general.
translations.idiomatic: He served in the Chu Army and rose through merit to deputy general.

sentences.zh: 蕭啟江援蜀，調從軍，以井研之捷，賜號果勇巴圖魯。

translations.literal: When Xiao Qijiang relieved Sichuan, Qinggao was transferred to his command; for the victory at Jingyan he was granted the title Guoyong Baturu.
translations.idiomatic: When Xiao Qijiang marched to relieve Sichuan, Qinggao was assigned to his command. For the victory at Jingyan he was granted the title Guoyong Baturu.

sentences.zh: 破李永和於資州，以總兵記名。

translations.literal: He defeated Li Yonghe at Zizhou and was enrolled by name as brigade general.
translations.idiomatic: He defeated Li Yonghe at Zizhou and was placed on the rolls as brigade general.

sentences.zh: 會剿藍朝柱，解綿州圍。

translations.literal: He joined the campaign against Lan Chaozhu and helped raise the siege of Mianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He took part in the campaign against Lan Chaozhu and helped lift the siege of Mianzhou.

sentences.zh: 同治二年，偕何勝必援漢中。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tongzhi he joined He Shengbi in relieving Hanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Tongzhi he joined He Shengbi in relieving Hanzhong.

sentences.zh: 油坊街之戰，勝必先敗，慶高赴援不及，同革職留軍。

translations.literal: At the battle of Youfangjie Shengbi was defeated first; Qinggao could not arrive in time to help, and both were dismissed from office but kept with the army.
translations.idiomatic: At Youfangjie Shengbi was beaten first. Qinggao could not reach him in time, and both were stripped of office but kept with the army.

sentences.zh: 三年，克漢中，同复官。

translations.literal: In the third year Hanzhong was recovered and both had their ranks restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year Hanzhong was recovered and both were restored to their former ranks.

sentences.zh: 追賊至城固，梯城而入，賊潰走。

translations.literal: Pursuing the rebels to Chenggu, he scaled the walls on ladders and the rebels broke and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Pursuing the rebels to Chenggu, his men scaled the walls on ladders; the rebels broke and fled.

sentences.zh: 四年，進攻洋縣，遣死士入城為內應，克之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he advanced on Yang County, sent dare-to-die troops into the city as inside agents, and took it.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he advanced on Yang County, sent dare-to-die men into the city as agents within the walls, and captured it.

sentences.zh: 賊酋曹燦章走踞八里坪，夾攻破之，燦章就擒，授漢中鎮總兵。

translations.literal: The bandit chief Cao Shenzhang fled to hold Baliuping; a converging attack broke him, Canzhang was captured, and Qinggao was appointed brigade general of Hanzhong Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: The bandit chief Cao Shenzhang fled to Baliuping. A combined assault overthrew him, Canzhang was taken, and Qinggao was appointed brigade general of Hanzhong Garrison.

sentences.zh: 五年，卒，諡武毅。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he died and was given the posthumous name Wuyi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he died and was given the posthumous name Wuyi.

sentences.zh: 楊復東，湖南瀏陽人。

translations.literal: Yang Fudong was a native of Liuyang, Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Fudong came from Liuyang in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 咸豐十年，從胡中和援蜀。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Xianfeng he followed Hu Zhonghe to relieve Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Xianfeng he followed Hu Zhonghe to relieve Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 十一年，戰富順牛腹渡，解大邑圍，擢守備。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he fought at Niufudu in Fushun, raised the siege of Dayi, and was promoted to garrison commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he fought at Niufudu in Fushun, helped lift the siege of Dayi, and was promoted to garrison commander.

sentences.zh: 敗藍朝柱於綿州，擢都司。

translations.literal: He defeated Lan Chaozhu at Mianzhou and was promoted to battalion commander.
translations.idiomatic: He defeated Lan Chaozhu at Mianzhou and was promoted to battalion commander.

sentences.zh: 又破朝柱於崇慶，毀石羊場，焚賊巢，擢游擊。

translations.literal: He defeated Chaozhu again at Chongqing, destroyed Shiyangchang, burned the rebel nest, and was promoted to colonel.
translations.idiomatic: He routed Chaozhu again at Chongqing, destroyed Shiyangchang, burned the rebel nest, and was promoted to colonel.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，复丹棱，擢參將。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he recovered Danling and was promoted to regimental commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi he recovered Danling and was promoted to regimental commander.

sentences.zh: 克青神，平鐵山賊壘，擒李永和。

translations.literal: He took Qingshen, leveled the bandit fort at Tieshan, and captured Li Yonghe.
translations.idiomatic: He captured Qingshen, leveled the bandit fort at Tieshan, and took Li Yonghe prisoner.

sentences.zh: 擢副將。

translations.literal: He was promoted to deputy general.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to deputy general.

sentences.zh: 五年，總督駱秉章疏陳復東歷年防剿滇、黔諸賊功多，以總兵記名。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Governor-General Luo Bingzhang memorialized that Fudong's years of campaigning against Yunnan and Guizhou rebels had earned great merit, and he was enrolled by name as brigade general.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Governor-General Luo Bingzhang memorialized that through years of campaigning against rebels in Yunnan and Guizhou Fudong had rendered distinguished service, and he was placed on the rolls as brigade general.

sentences.zh: 七年，授四川川北鎮總兵。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was appointed brigade general of Chuandong Garrison in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was appointed brigade general of Chuandong Garrison in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 光緒二年，調雲南開化鎮。

translations.literal: In the second year of Guangxu he was transferred to Kaifeng Garrison in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Guangxu he was transferred to Kaifeng Garrison in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 六年，卒。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he died.

sentences.zh: 周達武，字夢熊，湖南寧鄉人。

translations.literal: Zhou Dawu, styled Mengxiong, was a native of Ningxiang, Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Dawu, whose style was Mengxiong, came from Ningxiang in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 咸豐四年，應募入李續賓營，從克岳州、武昌，累功擢守備。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Xianfeng he enlisted in Li Xubin's battalion, followed in the capture of Yuezhou and Wuchang, and through accumulated merit was promoted to garrison commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Xianfeng he enlisted in Li Xubin's battalion, took part in capturing Yuezhou and Wuchang, and rose through merit to garrison commander.

sentences.zh: 戰湖口，晉都司。

translations.literal: At the battle of Hukou he was promoted to battalion commander.
translations.idiomatic: At the battle of Hukou he was promoted to battalion commander.

sentences.zh: 達武每戰陷陣，手大旗盪決，續賓異之，使領百人曰信字營，常為軍鋒。

translations.literal: In every battle Dawu charged the line, brandishing the great banner to break the enemy; Xubin marveled at him and gave him command of a hundred men called the Xinzi Battalion, and he was often the army's spearhead.
translations.idiomatic: In every fight Dawu plunged into the fray, sweeping forward with the great standard. Xubin took notice of him and gave him command of a hundred men in the Xinzi Battalion, and he was often the army's vanguard.

sentences.zh: 八年，克黃安，擢游擊，賜花翎。

translations.literal: In the eighth year Huang'an was taken and he was promoted to colonel and given a peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Huang'an was captured and he was promoted to colonel and awarded a peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 從續賓攻舒城，達武率死士先登，左耳受槍傷，克城後，留守。

translations.literal: Following Xubin in the attack on Shucheng, Dawu led dare-to-die troops to scale the walls first, was wounded in the left ear by a musket ball, and after the city fell remained to garrison it.
translations.idiomatic: Following Xubin against Shucheng, Dawu led dare-to-die men over the walls first, took a musket wound in the left ear, and after the city fell was left to hold it.

sentences.zh: 俄續賓覆軍三河，舒城守軍亦潰，達武以創重回湖南。

translations.literal: Soon Xubin's army was destroyed at Sanhe and the Shucheng garrison also collapsed; Dawu returned to Hunan with his wounds.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Xubin's army was annihilated at Sanhe and the Shucheng garrison broke as well. Dawu returned to Hunan to recover from his wounds.

sentences.zh: 九年，石達開圍寶慶，巡撫駱秉章令達武募五百人號曰章武軍，從知府劉岳昭援寶慶，守東關，屢拒戰破賊。

translations.literal: In the ninth year Shi Dakai besieged Baoding; Governor Luo Bingzhang ordered Dawu to raise five hundred men called the Zhangwu Army, follow Prefect Liu Yuezhao to relieve Baoding, hold the East Gate, and repeatedly repulsed the rebels in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year Shi Dakai besieged Baoding. Governor Luo Bingzhang ordered Dawu to raise five hundred men as the Zhangwu Army, follow Prefect Liu Yuezhao to the relief, hold the East Gate, and beat back the rebels again and again.

sentences.zh: 圍解，擢參將。

translations.literal: When the siege was raised he was promoted to regimental commander.
translations.idiomatic: When the siege was lifted he was promoted to regimental commander.

sentences.zh: 十年，援廣西，克富川平古城、連塘賊壘，复賀縣，擢副將，加總兵銜。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he relieved Guangxi, took the rebel forts at Pinggucheng and Liantang in Fuchuan, recovered He County, was promoted to deputy general, and given the rank of brigade general.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he marched to relieve Guangxi, captured the rebel forts at Pinggucheng and Liantang in Fuchuan, recovered He County, was promoted to deputy general, and given brigade-general rank.

sentences.zh: 石達開分黨犯永明、柘牌，連戰破之，擢總兵。

translations.literal: When Shi Dakai sent partisans against Yongming and Zhepai, Dawu defeated them in successive battles and was promoted to brigade general.
translations.idiomatic: When Shi Dakai dispatched followers against Yongming and Zhepai, Dawu defeated them in battle after battle and was promoted to brigade general.

sentences.zh: 十一年，會諸軍克會同，賊走湖北，陷來鳳。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he joined the allied armies in taking Huitong; the rebels fled to Hubei and took Laifeng.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he joined the allied armies in capturing Huitong. The rebels fled to Hubei and seized Laifeng.

sentences.zh: 同治元年春，從劉岳昭攻克之，予二品封典。

translations.literal: In the spring of the first year of Tongzhi he followed Liu Yuezhao in taking it and was granted a second-rank fief privilege.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the first year of Tongzhi he followed Liu Yuezhao in recovering Laifeng and was granted a second-rank fief privilege.

sentences.zh: 駱秉章督師四川，調達武從剿。

translations.literal: When Luo Bingzhang took command in Sichuan, Dawu was transferred to join the suppression campaign.
translations.idiomatic: When Luo Bingzhang assumed command in Sichuan, Dawu was transferred to join the campaign of suppression.

sentences.zh: 抵涪州，會賊酋周紹勇由大寧竄陝西，達武扼之窄子口，地當兩山間，令部將李輝武逾險而入，賊潰走，追至大竹安吉場，擒紹勇及其黨吳崇禮等，檻送成都斬之，賜號質勇巴圖魯。

translations.literal: Reaching Fuzhou, he encountered the rebel chief Zhou Shaoyong, who had broken out from Daning into Shaanxi. Dawu blocked him at Zhaizikou, a place between two mountains, ordered his subordinate Li Huiwu to cross the difficult terrain and enter, the rebels broke and fled, and he pursued to Anji Field in Dazhu, captured Shaoyong and his follower Wu Chongli and others, sent them in cages to Chengdu for execution, and was granted the title Zhiyong Baturu.
translations.idiomatic: At Fuzhou he met the rebel chief Zhou Shaoyong breaking out from Daning into Shaanxi. Dawu blocked him at Zhaizikou between two mountain ranges, ordered his lieutenant Li Huiwu to cross the difficult ground and strike in, the rebels broke and fled, and he pursued to Anji Field in Dazhu. Shaoyong and his follower Wu Chongli were captured, sent in cages to Chengdu for execution, and Dawu was granted the title Zhiyong Baturu.

sentences.zh: 又破郭刀刀於儀隴大​​儀寨，陣斬其弟佔彪及悍黨馬玉音，追奔至巴州鼎山鋪，擒刀刀，餘黨皆降。

translations.literal: He also defeated Guo Daodao at Dayizhai in Yilong, slew Daodao's brother Zhanbiao and the fierce follower Ma Yuyin in battle, pursued the rout to Dingshanpu in Bazhou, captured Daodao, and the remaining followers all surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: He also defeated Guo Daodao at Dayizhai in Yilong, slew Daodao's brother Zhanbiao and the fierce follower Ma Yuyin in the field, pursued the rout to Dingshanpu in Bazhou, captured Daodao, and the rest all surrendered.

sentences.zh: 紹勇與刀刀並為蜀中劇賊，至是悉平，授四川建昌鎮總兵，加提督銜。

translations.literal: Shaoyong and Daodao were the fiercest rebels in Shu; with both now pacified, Dawu was appointed brigade general of Jianchang Garrison in Sichuan and given the rank of provincial military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoyong and Daodao had been the most formidable rebels in Sichuan. Now that both were subdued, Dawu was appointed brigade general of Jianchang Garrison and given provincial military commissioner rank.

sentences.zh: 二年，護理提督。

translations.literal: In the second year he served as acting provincial military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he served as acting provincial military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 粵匪陳得才圍漢中，眾號十萬，石達開亦由高縣走寧遠，全蜀大震。

translations.literal: The Taiping rebel Chen Deicai besieged Hanzhong with a host said to number one hundred thousand; Shi Dakai also marched from Gaoxian toward Ningyuan, and all of Sichuan was shaken.
translations.idiomatic: The Taiping rebel Chen Deicai besieged Hanzhong with forces said to number one hundred thousand. Shi Dakai also marched from Gaoxian toward Ningyuan, and all Sichuan was thrown into alarm.

sentences.zh: 達武增募軍四千人，往來游擊。

translations.literal: Dawu raised his army by four thousand men and ranged back and forth in mobile operations.
translations.idiomatic: Dawu enlarged his force by four thousand men and ranged the countryside in mobile operations.

sentences.zh: 三年，得才之黨梁福成合川匪蔡昌齡由漢中竄甘肅階州，達武議以剿為防，率師越境，攻克江東水、嚴家灣賊壘。

translations.literal: In the third year Deicai's follower Liang Fucheng joined the Sichuan bandit Cai Changling in breaking from Hanzhong into Jiezhou in Gansu. Dawu argued that suppression was the best defense, crossed the border with his army, and took the rebel forts at Jiangdongshui and Yanjiawan.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year Deicai's follower Liang Fucheng united with the Sichuan bandit Cai Changling in breaking from Hanzhong into Jiezhou, Gansu. Dawu held that the best defense was to pursue and destroy them, crossed the border with his army, and captured the rebel forts at Jiangdongshui and Yanjiawan.

sentences.zh: 進攻階州，自將台山穴地達城根，地雷發，城崩，選鋒四百人先入，大軍繼之，遂克階州，斬福成、昌齡。

translations.literal: Advancing on Jiezhou, he himself tunneled from Jiangtai Hill to reach the foot of the wall; the mine exploded, the wall collapsed, four hundred picked men entered first, the main army followed, Jiezhou was taken, and Fucheng and Changling were beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing the attack on Jiezhou, he personally drove a tunnel from Jiangtai Hill to the base of the wall. The mine detonated, the wall collapsed, four hundred picked men went in first, the main force followed, Jiezhou fell, and Fucheng and Changling were beheaded.

sentences.zh: 以提督記名，並頒珍賚。

translations.literal: He was enrolled by name as provincial military commissioner and received imperial gifts.
translations.idiomatic: He was placed on the rolls as provincial military commissioner and received imperial gifts of commendation.

sentences.zh: 尋平松潘叛番，授貴州提督，仍留防重慶，備滇邊。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he pacified the rebellious Tibetans of Songpan, was appointed Yunnan provincial military commissioner, yet remained to guard Chongqing on the Yunnan frontier.
translations.idiomatic: He soon pacified the rebellious Tibetans of Songpan, was appointed Yunnan provincial military commissioner, yet remained at Chongqing to guard the Yunnan frontier.

sentences.zh: 五年，剿平馬邊廳教匪，斬匪首宋仕傑、熊文才。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he suppressed the religious bandits of Mabian Subprefecture and beheaded the bandit chiefs Song Shijie and Xiong Wencai.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he suppressed the religious bandits of Mabian Subprefecture and beheaded the chiefs Song Shijie and Xiong Wencai.

sentences.zh: 六年，捻匪竄陝西，左宗棠諮調會剿，令部將李輝武率三千赴陝。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Nian bandits entered Shaanxi; Zuo Zongtang consulted and transferred Dawu to join the campaign, ordering his lieutenant Li Huiwu to lead three thousand men into Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Nian bandits raided Shaanxi. Zuo Zongtang called Dawu to join the campaign and ordered Li Huiwu to lead three thousand men into Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 七年，破越巂倮夷於普雄，進克西昌交腳夷巢，斬級數千，諸夷悉降，賜黃馬褂，晉號博奇巴圖魯。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he defeated the Yi of Yuexi at Puxiong, advanced to take the Yi nest at Jiaojiao in Xichang, slew several thousand, and all the tribes submitted; he was awarded a yellow jacket and advanced to Boqi Baturu.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he defeated the Yi of Yuexi at Puxiong, advanced to storm the Yi nest at Jiaojiao in Xichang, slew several thousand, and all the tribes submitted. He was awarded a yellow riding jacket and advanced in title to Boqi Baturu.

sentences.zh: 九年，詔赴貴州提督任，率所部六千人行，沿途平苗砦。

translations.literal: In the ninth year an edict ordered him to proceed to his post as Guizhou provincial military commissioner, leading six thousand of his troops; along the way he pacified Miao stockades.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was ordered to take up his post as Guizhou provincial military commissioner and marched with six thousand of his troops, pacifying Miao stockades all along the route.

sentences.zh: 先是貴州剿寇仰客軍，出省城百里即莫能製馭。

translations.literal: Previously Guizhou's campaigns against bandits had relied on guest armies from outside; once a hundred li beyond the provincial capital they could no longer control the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Until then Guizhou had depended on outside armies to fight its bandits; beyond a hundred li from the provincial capital no one could keep the enemy in check.

sentences.zh: 達武與巡撫議增募至三萬人，分任戰守，由龍里進凱渡，截上下游賊為二，复都勻，分軍破賊永寧、威寧。

translations.literal: Dawu discussed with the governor increasing recruitment to thirty thousand men, dividing duties between attack and defense, advancing from Longli toward Kaidu, cutting the upstream and downstream rebels in two, recovering Duyun, and sending detachments to defeat rebels at Yongning and Weining.
translations.idiomatic: Dawu and the governor agreed to raise the force to thirty thousand men, divide attack and defense, advance from Longli toward Kaidu, split the upstream and downstream rebels, recover Duyun, and dispatch columns to defeat the rebels at Yongning and Weining.

sentences.zh: 十年，遣鍾開蘭攻克麻哈州之高水塘等地數十砦；

translations.literal: In the tenth year he sent Zhong Kailan to take several dozen stockades including Gaoshuitang in Mahazhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he sent Zhong Kailan to capture several dozen stockades, including Gaoshuitang in Mahazhou.

sentences.zh: 遣何世華破粵賊李文彩、苗酋李高腳於都勻、獨山，收復八寨、三腳諸城，並克鎮寧、歸化及吳秀河、斑竹園諸苗砦，復清平、黃平二城。

translations.literal: He sent He Shihua to defeat the Guangdong rebel Li Wencai and the Miao chief Li Gaojiao at Duyun and Dushan, recover the cities of Bazhai and Sanjiao, and also take Zhenning, Guihua, and the Miao stockades at Wu Xiuhe and Banzhuyuan, recovering the cities of Qingping and Huangping.
translations.idiomatic: He sent He Shihua to defeat the Guangdong rebel Li Wencai and the Miao chief Li Gaojiao at Duyun and Dushan, recover Bazhai, Sanjiao, and other towns, and capture Zhenning, Guihua, and the Miao stockades at Wu Xiuhe and Banzhuyuan, restoring Qingping and Huangping.

sentences.zh: 始與楚軍席寶田合。

translations.literal: He first joined forces with Xi Baotian's Chu Army.
translations.idiomatic: For the first time he joined forces with Xi Baotian's Chu Army.

sentences.zh: 十一年，會席軍敗苗酋張臭迷之黨於茶牛坡，斬馘甚眾，降者數万。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he joined Xi's army in defeating the followers of the Miao chief Zhang Choumi at Chaniupo, slew a great number, and more than ten thousand surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he joined Xi's army in defeating the followers of the Miao chief Zhang Choumi at Chaniupo, killing a great host and accepting the surrender of tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 追至冷水溝，生擒賊酋，餘黨李高腳、李文彩竄荊蓬坎，分三路追擊，盡殄之。

translations.literal: Pursuing to Lengshuigou, the rebel chief was captured alive; the remaining followers Li Gaojiao and Li Wencai fled to Jingpengkan, and a three-pronged pursuit annihilated them completely.
translations.idiomatic: The pursuit reached Lengshuigou and the rebel chief was taken alive. Li Gaojiao and Li Wencai fled to Jingpengkan; a three-column pursuit wiped them out to the last man.

sentences.zh: 旋破群苗於清平香爐山，寶田擒張臭迷。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he broke the massed Miao at Xianglushan in Qingping; Baotian captured Zhang Choumi.
translations.idiomatic: He soon routed the massed Miao at Xianglushan in Qingping, and Baotian captured Zhang Choumi.

sentences.zh: 苗疆平，予騎都尉世職。

translations.literal: With the Miao frontier pacified he was granted a hereditary rank as Commandant of Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: With the Miao frontier pacified he was granted a hereditary Commandant of Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 光緒元年，乞病歸。

translations.literal: In the first year of Guangxu he pleaded illness and returned home.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Guangxu he pleaded illness and went home.

sentences.zh: 三年，授甘肅提督。

translations.literal: In the third year he was appointed Gansu provincial military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was appointed Gansu provincial military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十年，肅州妖民王林倡亂高台，討平之，斬王林。

translations.literal: In the tenth year the sorcerer Wang Lin of Suzhou incited rebellion at Gaotai; Dawu suppressed it and beheaded Wang Lin.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year the sorcerer Wang Lin stirred up rebellion at Gaotai in Suzhou. Dawu put it down and beheaded Wang Lin.

sentences.zh: 十九年，萬壽慶典，加尚書銜。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, on an imperial longevity celebration, he was given the rank of Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the nineteenth-year imperial longevity celebration he was given Minister rank.

sentences.zh: 二十年，卒官，賜卹，建專祠。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he died in office; posthumous honors were granted and a special temple was built.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he died in office. Posthumous honors were granted and a special temple was erected in his memory.

sentences.zh: 弟康祿，從達武勦賊廣西、湖南，歷保知縣。

translations.literal: His younger brother Kanglu followed Dawu in suppressing bandits in Guangxi and Hunan and through repeated recommendations rose to magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Kanglu followed Dawu in campaigns against bandits in Guangxi and Hunan and was repeatedly recommended until he reached the rank of magistrate.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，從赴蜀，破周紹勇，擢知州。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he followed him to Shu, defeated Zhou Shaoyong, and was promoted to prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi he followed him to Sichuan, helped defeat Zhou Shaoyong, and was promoted to prefect.

sentences.zh: 四年，從克階州，擢知府。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he followed in the capture of Jiezhou and was promoted to prefectural judge.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he took part in capturing Jiezhou and was promoted to prefectural judge.

sentences.zh: 從至貴州，總理營務。

translations.literal: Following Dawu to Guizhou, he took overall charge of camp affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When Dawu went to Guizhou, Kanglu took overall charge of camp affairs.

sentences.zh: 十一年，下游肅清，擢道員。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year the lower reaches were cleared and he was promoted to circuit intendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year the lower reaches were pacified and he was promoted to circuit intendant.

sentences.zh: 駐軍普安新城，招撫流亡。

translations.literal: Stationed at Xincheng in Pu'an, he recruited and settled displaced people.
translations.idiomatic: Stationed at Xincheng in Pu'an, he recruited refugees and restored order among the displaced.

sentences.zh: 十二年，會匪煽亂，康祿督親軍百人往討，眾寡不敵，死之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year secret-society bandits stirred up revolt; Kanglu led a hundred men of his personal guard to suppress them, was outnumbered, and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year secret-society bandits rose in revolt. Kanglu led a hundred men of his personal guard against them, was overwhelmed by superior numbers, and was killed.

sentences.zh: 贈內閣學士，予騎都尉世職，諡壯節。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made Grand Secretary, granted a hereditary Commandant of Cavalry, and given the posthumous name Zhuangjie.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Grand Secretary, granted a hereditary Commandant of Cavalry, and given the posthumous name Zhuangjie.

sentences.zh: 李輝武，湖南衡山人。

translations.literal: Li Huiwu was a native of Hengshan, Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Li Huiwu came from Hengshan in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 周達武部將。

translations.literal: A subordinate officer of Zhou Dawu.
translations.idiomatic: He was a subordinate officer under Zhou Dawu.

sentences.zh: 咸豐中，從剿粵匪，洊擢游擊。

translations.literal: In the Xianfeng years he followed campaigns against the Taiping rebels and was repeatedly promoted to colonel.
translations.idiomatic: During the Xianfeng years he campaigned against the Taiping rebels and was promoted in succession to colonel.

sentences.zh: 十一年，從入四川，剿涪川鶴遊坪踞賊，擒賊酋周紹勇、郭刀刀。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he entered Sichuan, suppressed rebels entrenched at Heyouping in Fuchuan, and captured the rebel chiefs Zhou Shaoyong and Guo Daodao.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he entered Sichuan, suppressed rebels holding Heyouping in Fuchuan, and captured the chiefs Zhou Shaoyong and Guo Daodao.

sentences.zh: 輝武功為多，擢副將，賜號武勇巴圖魯。

translations.literal: Huiwu's achievements were the greatest; he was promoted to deputy general and granted the title Wuyong Baturu.
translations.idiomatic: Huiwu's achievements stood foremost; he was promoted to deputy general and granted the title Wuyong Baturu.

sentences.zh: 同治三年，從援階州，輝武由伍家坪進軍，扼州城外北山條竹埡。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tongzhi he followed the relief of Jiezhou; Huiwu advanced from Wujiaping and held Tiaozhuya on the northern hills outside the city.
