translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Tongzhi he joined the relief of Jiezhou. Huiwu advanced from Wujiaping and seized Tiaozhuya on the northern hills outside the city.

sentences.zh: 四年，攻破橋頭里賊壘，又破賊於孟家莊，殲城外賊殆盡。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he stormed the rebel fort at Qiaotouli and defeated the rebels again at Mengjiazhuang, annihilating nearly all the rebels outside the walls.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he stormed the rebel fort at Qiaotouli and routed the enemy again at Mengjiazhuang, destroying nearly every rebel outside the walls.

sentences.zh: 穴地破城，輝武先登，擒賊目蔡四。

translations.literal: A mine was dug to breach the wall; Huiwu was first over and captured the rebel officer Cai Si.
translations.idiomatic: A mine brought down the wall; Huiwu was first to enter and captured the rebel officer Cai Si.

sentences.zh: 巡部，以總兵記名。

translations.literal: After inspecting the troops he was enrolled by name as brigade general.
translations.idiomatic: After reviewing the troops he was placed on the rolls as brigade general.

sentences.zh: 從討松潘叛番，拔其巢。

translations.literal: He followed the campaign against the rebellious Tibetans of Songpan and stormed their nest.
translations.idiomatic: He joined the campaign against the rebellious Tibetans of Songpan and stormed their stronghold.

sentences.zh: 尋攻黑河番，焚芝麻第五寨，餘寨皆降。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he attacked the Heihe Tibetans, burned the fifth stockade at Zhima, and the remaining stockades all surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: He soon attacked the Heihe Tibetans, burned the fifth stockade at Zhima, and the rest all submitted.

sentences.zh: 乘勝連破大松樹及竹自三寨，以提督記名。

translations.literal: Pressing the victory he took Dasongshu and the three stockades at Zhuzi in succession and was enrolled by name as provincial military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Following up his victories he captured Dasongshu and the three stockades at Zhuzi in succession and was placed on the rolls as provincial military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 六年，捻匪竄陝西，輝武率步隊五營赴援，剿破汧陽、隴州、寶雞諸賊，西路肅清。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Nian bandits entered Shaanxi; Huiwu led five infantry battalions to the relief, suppressed rebels at Qianyang, Longzhou, and Baoji, and the western route was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Nian bandits raided Shaanxi. Huiwu led five infantry battalions to the relief, broke rebels at Qianyang, Longzhou, and Baoji, and the western route was cleared.

sentences.zh: 八年，剿董志原竄匪，斃賊目王明章，晉號福凌阿巴圖魯，授漢中鎮總兵。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he suppressed fleeing bandits from Dongzhiyuan, killed the bandit leader Wang Mingzhang, was advanced to Fuling'a Baturu, and was appointed brigade general of Hanzhong Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he suppressed bandits fleeing from Dongzhiyuan, killed the bandit leader Wang Mingzhang, was advanced to Fuling'a Baturu, and was appointed brigade general of Hanzhong Garrison.

sentences.zh: 九年，偕提督劉端冕分擊北山回匪，破翟三、禹得彥於縣頭鎮、陳村。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he joined Provincial Military Commissioner Liu Duandian in a divided attack on Muslim rebels in the northern hills, defeating Zhai San and Yu Deyan at Xiantou Town and Chen Village.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he joined Provincial Military Commissioner Liu Duandian in a divided assault on Muslim rebels in the northern hills, defeating Zhai San and Yu Deyan at Xiantou Town and Chen Village.

sentences.zh: 十一年，擢甘肅提督，仍留防漢中。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was promoted to Gansu provincial military commissioner but remained to guard Hanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was promoted to Gansu provincial military commissioner yet remained to guard Hanzhong.

sentences.zh: 光緒四年，卒，賜卹。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Guangxu he died and posthumous honors were granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Guangxu he died and posthumous honors were granted.

sentences.zh: 輝武在漢中久，軍民相安。

translations.literal: Huiwu had long been stationed at Hanzhong, and soldiers and civilians lived in peace together.
translations.idiomatic: Huiwu had been stationed at Hanzhong for many years, and troops and civilians lived together in peace.

sentences.zh: 疏濬府城東河道達漢川，旁引溝渠以資灌溉，民食其利；

translations.literal: He dredged the eastern river channel of the prefectural city to reach the Han River and dug branch canals for irrigation, to the people's benefit.
translations.idiomatic: He dredged the river east of the prefectural seat so that it reached the Han River and opened branch canals for irrigation, to the lasting benefit of the people.

sentences.zh: 又修復褎斜棧道，商旅便焉。

translations.literal: He also restored the Baoxie plank road, to the convenience of merchants and travelers.
translations.idiomatic: He also restored the Baoxie plank road, which merchants and travelers found a great convenience.

sentences.zh: 沒後，士民籥請建祠，從之。

translations.literal: After his death the gentry and people petitioned for a temple to be built; the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: After his death the local gentry and people petitioned for a temple in his honor, and the court approved.

sentences.zh: 唐友耕，雲南大關廳人。

translations.literal: Tang Yougeng was a native of Daguan Subprefecture, Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Yougeng came from Daguan Subprefecture in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 咸豐中，滇匪起，陷賊，至四川敘州，自拔來歸。

translations.literal: In the Xianfeng years Yunnan rebels rose; he fell among the rebels, reached Xuzhou in Sichuan, and escaped to surrender to the government.
translations.idiomatic: When Yunnan rebels rose in the Xianfeng years he was caught up among them, reached Xuzhou in Sichuan, and broke away to surrender to the government.

sentences.zh: 從戰有功，授千總，署通江營守備。

translations.literal: Through fighting he earned merit, was appointed company commander, and served as acting garrison commander of Tongjiang Camp.
translations.idiomatic: He fought with distinction, was appointed company commander, and served as acting garrison commander of Tongjiang Camp.

sentences.zh: 賊擾​​鹽井，屢從戰擊走之，擢守備。

translations.literal: When bandits harassed the salt wells he repeatedly fought them off and was promoted to garrison commander.
translations.idiomatic: When bandits raided the salt wells he drove them off again and again and was promoted to garrison commander.

sentences.zh: 十年，戰峨眉索橋，受傷，破賊雙福場，進平天全茅山賊壘，擢都司，賜號額勒莫克依巴圖魯。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he fought at Suoqiao in Emei, was wounded, defeated rebels at Shuangfuchang, advanced to pacify the bandit fort at Maoshan in Tianquan, was promoted to battalion commander, and was granted the title Elemokeyi Baturu.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he fought at Suoqiao in Emei, was wounded, routed rebels at Shuangfuchang, advanced to pacify the bandit fort at Maoshan in Tianquan, was promoted to battalion commander, and was granted the title Elemokeyi Baturu.

sentences.zh: 十一年，援潼川，破賊解圍，擢副將。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he relieved Tongchuan, defeated the rebels and raised the siege, and was promoted to deputy general.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he relieved Tongchuan, broke the rebels and lifted the siege, and was promoted to deputy general.

sentences.zh: 駱秉章督師至蜀，檄友耕會諸軍援綿州，令自石橋鋪進攻，友耕觀望不前，被劾，褫職留營。

translations.literal: When Luo Bingzhang arrived in Shu to take command he ordered Yougeng to join the allied armies in relieving Mianzhou and to advance from Shiqiaopu; Yougeng held back and did not advance, was impeached, and was stripped of office but kept with the army.
translations.idiomatic: When Luo Bingzhang came to Sichuan as commander he ordered Yougeng to join the relief of Mianzhou and advance from Shiqiaopu. Yougeng hung back and would not move forward, was impeached, stripped of office, but kept with the army.

sentences.zh: 既而會援眉州，友耕軍先至，戰比有功，圍解，復原官。

translations.literal: Later he joined the relief of Meizhou; Yougeng's army arrived first and fought with some success; the siege was raised and his original rank was restored.
translations.idiomatic: He later joined the relief of Meizhou. Yougeng's troops arrived first and fought creditably; the siege was lifted and his former rank was restored.

sentences.zh: 戰青神，陣斬賊目張興，身被二傷，裹創力戰，賊大敗。

translations.literal: At the battle of Qingshen he slew the rebel officer Zhang Xing in the field, received two wounds, bound them and fought on, and the rebels suffered a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: At Qingshen he slew the rebel officer Zhang Xing in battle, took two wounds, bound them and kept fighting, and the rebels were routed.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，破石達開黨賴裕新於工卩州。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he defeated Shi Dakai's follower Lai Yuxin at Gongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi he defeated Shi Dakai's follower Lai Yuxin at Gongzhou.

sentences.zh: 三月，達開圍涪州，友耕馳援，解其圍，授四川重慶鎮總兵。

translations.literal: In the third month Dakai besieged Fuzhou; Yougeng rushed to the relief, raised the siege, and was appointed brigade general of Chongqing Garrison in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Dakai besieged Fuzhou. Yougeng galloped to the rescue, lifted the siege, and was appointed brigade general of Chongqing Garrison in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 會諸軍复長寧，賊引去。

translations.literal: The allied armies recovered Changning and the rebels withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The allied armies recovered Changning and the rebels withdrew.

sentences.zh: 是年冬，達開屯敘州雙龍場，分黨屯橫江，友耕攻破江岸賊壘。

translations.literal: That winter Dakai encamped at Shuanglongchang in Xuzhou and sent partisans to hold Hengjiang; Yougeng stormed the rebel forts on the riverbank.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Dakai encamped at Shuanglongchang in Xuzhou and posted followers at Hengjiang. Yougeng stormed the rebel forts along the riverbank.

sentences.zh: 二年春，賊由橫江竄新灘溪，與屏山隔一水，友耕慮賊乘間偷渡，乃濟江設伏，誘賊深入，敗之。

translations.literal: In the spring of the second year the rebels fled from Hengjiang to Xintanxi, separated from Pingshan by only a stream; fearing they would steal a crossing, Yougeng crossed the river, set an ambush, lured them deep, and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the second year the rebels broke from Hengjiang toward Xintanxi, with only a stream between them and Pingshan. Fearing a surprise crossing, Yougeng crossed the river, laid an ambush, drew the enemy in deep, and routed them.

sentences.zh: 六月，達開謀渡金沙江，官軍扼之不得進，改趨天全土司地，友耕擊沉賊筏；

translations.literal: In the sixth month Dakai planned to cross the Jinsha River but the government army blocked him; he turned toward the tribal lands of Tianquan, and Yougeng sank the rebel rafts.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Dakai tried to cross the Jinsha River but government troops barred his way. He turned toward the tribal lands of Tianquan, and Yougeng sank the rebel rafts.

sentences.zh: 達開奔老鴉漩，復為土兵所遏，遂就擒。

translations.literal: Dakai fled to Laoyaxuan, was blocked again by tribal soldiers, and was then captured.
translations.idiomatic: Dakai fled to Laoyaxuan, was blocked by tribal troops, and was captured.

sentences.zh: 友耕擢雲南提督，留屯川南。

translations.literal: Yougeng was promoted to Yunnan provincial military commissioner and remained to garrison southern Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Yougeng was promoted to Yunnan provincial military commissioner and remained to garrison southern Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 四年，丁母憂，詔改署提督，友耕請終制，許之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, upon his mother's death, an edict changed his appointment to acting commissioner; Yougeng asked to complete the mourning period and was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, when his mother died, an edict appointed him acting commissioner instead; Yougeng asked to observe the full mourning period and was allowed.

sentences.zh: 七年服闋，署四川總督崇實奏緩陛見，令募勇防川北。

translations.literal: When mourning ended in the seventh year, Acting Governor-General Chong Shi of Sichuan memorialized to defer his audience at court and ordered him to raise troops to guard northern Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: When his mourning ended in the seventh year, Acting Governor-General Chong Shi of Sichuan memorialized to defer his court audience and ordered him to raise troops to guard northern Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 八年，調赴雲南，招降回寇李本忠等，賜黃馬褂。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was transferred to Yunnan, induced Muslim bandits including Li Benzhong to surrender, and was awarded a yellow riding jacket.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was transferred to Yunnan, induced Muslim bandits including Li Benzhong to surrender, and was awarded a yellow riding jacket.

sentences.zh: 光緒六年，署四川提督，八年，卒。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Guangxu he served as acting Sichuan provincial military commissioner; in the eighth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Guangxu he served as acting Sichuan provincial military commissioner. In the eighth year he died.

sentences.zh: 論曰：雷正綰、陶茂林、曹克忠皆多隆阿部下戰將。

translations.literal: The appraisal says: Lei Zhengwan, Tao Maolin, and Cao Kezhong were all battle commanders under Duo Longa.
translations.idiomatic: The appraisal states: Lei Zhengwan, Tao Maolin, and Cao Kezhong were all fighting generals who had served under Duo Longa.

sentences.zh: 多隆阿歿後，甘肅軍事實倚三人，以餉匱兵變，遂難成功。

translations.literal: After Duo Longa's death Gansu military affairs in fact relied on these three men, but with supplies exhausted and troops mutinying, success proved impossible.
translations.idiomatic: After Duo Longa's death the military situation in Gansu in fact rested on these three men, yet with pay short and armies mutinying, victory eluded them.

sentences.zh: 克忠較有謀略，其軍獨全，終以病引退，後猶稱為宿將。

translations.literal: Kezhong was comparatively the most resourceful; his army alone remained intact; he finally retired on grounds of illness, yet afterward was still called a veteran commander.
translations.idiomatic: Kezhong was the most astute of the three; his army alone stayed intact. He eventually withdrew on grounds of illness, yet was still spoken of afterward as a veteran commander.

sentences.zh: 胡中和、周達武等皆以楚軍平蜀寇。

translations.literal: Hu Zhonghe, Zhou Dawu, and others all pacified the bandits of Shu with the Chu Army.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Zhonghe, Zhou Dawu, and the others all pacified Sichuan's rebels with the Chu Army.

sentences.zh: 唐友耕以蜀軍頡頏其間，並躋專閫。

translations.literal: Tang Yougeng, as a Sichuan army man, held his own among them and likewise rose to independent command.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Yougeng, commanding Sichuan troops, held his own in their company and likewise rose to independent high command.

sentences.zh: 達武晚任貴州軍事，與席寶田同定苗疆，建樹較閎達焉。

translations.literal: In his later years Dawu held military authority in Guizhou; together with Xi Baotian he finally pacified the Miao frontier, and his achievements were the more far-reaching.
translations.idiomatic: In his later years Dawu held military authority in Guizhou. Together with Xi Baotian he finally pacified the Miao frontier, and his accomplishments were the greater and more enduring.
